Description: SWE-bench Verified evaluates software engineering by asking models to generate patches that fix real GitHub issues in Python repositories, with tasks filtered/verified to be solvable and reliably testable. Submissions are judged by whether the repository’s tests pass after applying the patch, emphasizing end-to-end debugging and code modification rather than isolated coding puzzles.
Cognitive Functions:

L2: Logical Reasoning, Planning, Working Memory, Semantic Understanding & Context Recognition
L3: Inhibitory Control (minor)

Description: SWE-bench Multilingual extends the SWE-bench paradigm beyond Python to multiple programming languages, requiring models to understand diverse ecosystems, libraries, and idioms. It tests whether agentic code-repair competence transfers across languages and tooling while maintaining correct, test-passing changes.
Cognitive Functions:
L1: Language Comprehension (minor)
L2: Logical Reasoning, Planning, Working Memory, Semantic Understanding & Context Recognition
L3: Cognitive Flexibility

Description: SWE-bench Pro is a larger, more difficult software engineering benchmark intended to be more challenging and more resistant to contamination than earlier SWE-bench variants, spanning multiple languages and more industrially realistic tasks. Cognitive Functions:

L3: Inhibitory Control (minor)
